entities.summary: Johann Ernst Oswald Schmiedeberg was a Baltic German pharmacologist. In 1866 he earned his medical doctorate from the Imperial University of Dorpat with a thesis concerning the measurement of chloroform in blood, before becoming the first professor of pharmacology at the University of Strasbourg, where he remained for 46 years.
